title: Meeting Room Scheduler
summary: Interval conflicts, best-fit room selection, cancellation, free-slot computation and a single-winner booking race. A common Amazon/Microsoft question.
hints: Half-open intervals `[start, end)`: two bookings conflict iff `s1 < e2 && s2 < e1`.
Per room, keep bookings sorted by start (a `TreeMap<start, Booking>` or a sorted slice). Then a conflict check only needs the neighbours.
Best fit: filter rooms with `capacity ≥ attendees` and no conflict, then pick the min by `(capacity, id)`.
Free slots: walk the sorted bookings inside `[from, to)` and emit the gaps.
